  515 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnStatusInflicted.add(:SYNCHRONIZE,
  516   proc { |ability, battler, user, status|
  517     next if !user || user.index == battler.index
  518     case status
  519     when :POISON
  520       if user.pbCanPoisonSynchronize?(battler)
  521         battler.battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  522         msg = nil
  523         if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  524           msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} poisoned {3}!", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
  525         end
  526         user.pbPoison(nil, msg, (battler.statusCount > 0))
  527         battler.battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  528       end
  529     when :BURN
  530       if user.pbCanBurnSynchronize?(battler)
  531         battler.battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  532         msg = nil
  533         if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  534           msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} burned {3}!", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
  535         end
  536         user.pbBurn(nil, msg)
  537         battler.battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  538       end
  539     when :PARALYSIS
  540       if user.pbCanParalyzeSynchronize?(battler)
  541         battler.battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  542         msg = nil
  543         if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  544           msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} paralyzed {3}! It may be unable to move!",
  545              battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
  546         end
  547         user.pbParalyze(nil, msg)
  548         battler.battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  549       end
  550     end
  551   }
  552 )

  610 Battle::AbilityEffects::StatusCure.add(:OBLIVIOUS,
  611   proc { |ability, battler|
  612     next if battler.effects[PBEffects::Attract] < 0 &&
  613             (battler.effects[PBEffects::Taunt] == 0 || Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION <= 5)
  614     battler.battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  615     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0
  616       battler.pbCureAttract
  617       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  618         battler.battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} got over its infatuation.", battler.pbThis))
  619       else
  620         battler.battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} cured its infatuation status!",
  621            battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
  622       end
  623     end
  624     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0 && Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
  625       battler.effects[PBEffects::Taunt] = 0
  626       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  627         battler.battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s Taunt wore off!", battler.pbThis))
  628       else
  629         battler.battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} made its taunt wear off!",
  630            battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
